title: deviceApprovalInput
responsibility: Validates and reconstructs the four device approval commands from an untrusted Electron renderer payload.

inputs.name: deviceApprovalInput.value
inputs.description: Untrusted IPC message. A mailbox must be a 32-digit lowercase hexadecimal ID; an approval also requires the six-digit comparison code.

outputs.name: deviceApprovalInput
outputs.description: A listed, reviewed, approved or denied request command, or undefined if the input is invalid.
